    values = {}
    result = None
    leaves = {}
    for pname, tname in module["params"]:

        values[pname] = v
        for path, leaf in sub.items():

    rname, rtname = module["result"]
    rv, sub = gen.value(rtname)

        k, int_value, w = leaves[key]
        assert w == width, (key, w, width)
        objs.append((name, int_value.to_bytes(width, 'little')))
